summary: Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. III, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K disclosing a fee agreement tied to its upcoming business combination with Air Water Ventures Holdings Limited and PubCo. A service provider may earn a cash fee equal to 125,000 times the redemption price if it holds that many unredeemed Class A shares at closing; as of filing it held none. Redemption requests totaled 24,673,661 shares as of July 27, 2026. The transaction was approved via proxy/prospectus on Form F-4 declared effective July 8, 2026. Watch for final redemption levels and closing conditions.
